claims.claim: banded killifish has no bioenergetics model of its own; the congener's is the California killifish's (Madon et al. 2001)
claims.note: FB4's parameter file (read for Deslauriers_etal_2017: docs/research_notes/fetched/v2/Deslauriers_etal_2017.Parameters_official.csv) lists 'California Killifish (juvenile & adult), Fundulus parvipinnis', source 'Madon et al. 2001', and no Fundulus diaphanus set — an intermediary record that the parameter set exists under this citation; the article itself is unread

claims.claim: the California killifish set (Madon et al. 2001): CTM 34 °C, ACT 1.25 — respiration outruns intake below ~75 % of Cmax on 3,300-J/g prey; fit to a salt-marsh fish
claims.note: FB4's row for Madon et al. 2001 gives CEQ 2, CA 0.2, CB −0.25, CQ 2.22, CTO 27, CTM 34; REQ 2, RA 0.02, RB −0.17, RQ 2, RTO 29, RTM 36; ACT 1.25, SDA 0.1; FA 0.1, UA 0.06; ED 5,021 J/g — consistent with the code's CTM 34 and ACT 1.25. Until the article is read, cite these as 'Madon et al. 2001, as tabulated in FB4 (Deslauriers et al. 2017)'. The 75 % / starvation result is the project's own simulation
